decision: Confirm stays disabled until all six code digits are entered
why: Handing goods to the wrong person is the costliest error at the counter.
alternative: A confirm button with an 'are you sure?' dialog.
value: The safe path is the only path, without an extra click.

decision: Third-party pickup is a stacked sub-modal that keeps the order visible
why: Staff need the order context while verifying someone else's identity.
alternative: Navigate to a separate authorization page.
value: Nested decisions stay in context and the URL reproduces both layers.

decision: Authorization comes from the customer's app, checked against the last 4 ID digits
why: The customer delegates in advance; the counter only verifies, so policy lives in one service.
alternative: Staff judgment plus a signed paper slip.
value: Consistent fraud controls across every store.

decision: Store only the match result and staff badge, never the ID photo
why: Identity documents are sensitive and unnecessary once matched.
alternative: Photograph the ID for the audit trail.
value: Less personal data at rest, same audit strength.
